name: The Transcript
zh_summary: TheTranscript_ cites 2027 cloud guidance: $MSFT Azure growth 49-50% CC in Q2 FY27; $AMZN sees AWS above 40% in 2027 and 2028 toward $1T revenue in 5-10 years; $GOOGL Cloud backlog $561B with TPU sales ramping into 2027.
en_summary: TheTranscript_ cites 2027 cloud guidance: $MSFT Azure growth 49-50% CC in Q2 FY27; $AMZN sees AWS above 40% in 2027 and 2028 toward $1T revenue in 5-10 years; $GOOGL Cloud backlog $561B with TPU sales ramping into 2027.
text:
Big Tech expects strong cloud growth to continue into 2027:

$MSFT CFO: "In Azure [For Q2 FY27], we expect revenue growth of 49% to 50% in constant currency with continued efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet, helping to offset some 3P GPU-as-a-Service contracts that have been delayed to H2.

$AMZN CEO: "...we believe that AWS can grow north of 40% in each of 2027 and in 2028, and be a $1 trillion revenue business in the next 5 to 10 years. We're in the very early days of this inflection"

$GOOGL CFO: "Google Cloud's backlog was $561 billion in Q3, with the majority of the backlog related to typical GCP contracts. We expect to recognize just over 55% of the total backlog as revenues over the next 24 months...In Google Cloud, we expect TPU system sales to continue to scale in Q4, followed by a meaningful revenue ramp in 2027"

text:
Cloud growth is accelerating across Big Tech:

$AMZN CEO: "AWS grew 39.3% year-over-year, accelerating for the sixth straight quarter, our fastest growth in nearly 5 years. Backlog is $578 billion, growing triple digits year-over-year and well diversified."
